notes: OpenSPP is a social-protection registry built on Odoo, and its externally reachable API has two halves, both described here. (1) Odoo's external API, which is RPC and not REST: the openspp adaptor uses the odoo-await client, which speaks XML-RPC at POST /xmlrpc/2/common (authenticate) and POST /xmlrpc/2/object (execute_kw) with text/xml bodies; POST /web/session/authenticate and POST /jsonrpc are Odoo's JSON equivalents and are modelled with JSON schemas so the record shapes the adaptor actually reads (res.partner registrants, g2p.group.membership, g2p.program, g2p.program_membership, spp.service.point, spp.area — the Odoo* component schemas) are captured. (2) OpenSPP's own REST API v2 (the spp_api_v2 FastAPI module family, base path /api/v2/spp), authored from the module reference pages: Individual, Group, Program, ProgramMembership, Cycle, Entitlement, Product/ProductCategory/UnitOfMeasure, ServicePoint, Vocabulary and Data push/pull. BEST-EFFORT, reason rpc-transport, for two independent reasons. First, execute_kw dispatches model methods by name at runtime, so the XML-RPC/JSON-RPC surface is two endpoints wide and open-ended in depth — OpenAPI cannot enumerate it, and the XML wire format cannot be described at all (those two operations carry text/xml string bodies). Second, the REST API v2 docs give endpoint tables and response-field tables but no list envelope or full payload examples, so search endpoints are modelled as bare arrays of the documented fields and each such operation says so; a deployment's own generated schema at /api/v2/spp/openapi.json is the authority there. This replaces an earlier synthesized spec that projected the adaptor's twenty operations onto invented REST paths (/groups/{spp_id}, /individuals/search, ...) which no OpenSPP instance has ever served: all ten openfn-mocker exchanges were unknown-operation against it. Cross-checked against ast.json (20 operations, all funnelling through execute_kw), the adaptor source, odoo-await's transport, and the mocker's recorded XML-RPC traffic, which now conforms with 0 violations.
